https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/108LJSTazkh4Ikfe2PiFvQmI_qIiiBlPr?usp=sharing

1 character. 17 year old male who looks feminine. So, otokonoko to put it in familiar terms. The context is that this character was castrated at a young age and didn't go through male puberty. Think of like gwyndolin from dark souls as a reference for how the body would look. Feminine face too, with long silver-grey hair parted at a 7:3 ratio. He has a big scar going across his eyes from a blade wound when he was a child. His eyes are still there but he is blind, so there should be a dullness to them. He wears a feather coat meant for travelling, and beneath it a robe like something a shepherd would wear with a rope that ties the waist.

He should be turned away from the camera but looking back over his shoulder at the camera. Background doesn't have to be anything complicated, but earthy tones are better than anything else. His face should be a slight frown but something fitting confusion and caution not sadness.

This is my OC called Julia btw. You are free to take creative liberty
